description:
National provisions implementing one EU provision, with method and confidence per link. DERIVED data, not published by any authority: treat links not marked method='human' as leads to verify, and say so when citing. Check evidenceStatus: a current national consolidated reading aid may be informative rather than authoritative, and older links may be stale.

Lexiara Nexus data requires an API key on a signed-in account. The free plan carries a monthly Nexus allowance; the legislative text itself is always free.

eId.description: Provision identifier: 'sec_4' (section 4), 'art_2__para_1' (article 2(1)), 'sch_9' (Schedule 9). Use search or history endpoints to discover eIds.
